mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.course_id, c.teacher_id, c.description, c.created_time, co.name as course_name, co.description as course_description, u.username as teacher_username, u.nickname as teacher_nickname, u.real_name as teacher_real_name, u.email as teacher_email FROM classes c LEFT JOIN courses co ON c.course_id = co.id AND co.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users u ON c.teacher_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.course_id, c.teacher_id, c.description, c.created_time FROM classes c WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY c.created_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.course_id, c.teacher_id, c.description, c.created_time FROM classes c INNER JOIN student_classes sc ON c.id = sc.class_id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sc.join_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.course_id, c.teacher_id, c.description, c.created_time, sc.join_time as join_time, co.name as course_name, co.description as course_description, u.username as teacher_username, u.nickname as teacher_nickname, u.real_name as teacher_real_name, u.email as teacher_email FROM classes c INNER JOIN student_classes sc ON c.id = sc.class_id LEFT JOIN courses co ON c.course_id = co.id AND co.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users u ON c.teacher_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sc.join_time DESC
